{{Quote|Stand back, stand back! GA Security has jurisdiction here!|A GA Security trooper|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
'''Galactic Alliance Security''', also referred to as '''GA Security''' or simply '''GAS''', was a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] and paramilitary force of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]. Operating primarily on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the GAS was formed in the aftermath of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. With the dismantling of the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]], the GA government formed Galactic Alliance Security to serve as its law enforcement arm, separate from the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force]]. The [[Head of Galactic Alliance Security]] served as both the commander of GAS and as the [[Director of Galactic Alliance Intelligence]]. The move ensured that information would move smoothly between the organizations but not in effect recreate the secret police that the Galactic Alliance Guard had been. The everyday GAS operations were based out of a [[Galactic Alliance Security blockhouse|blockhouse]] in the [[Senate District/Legends|government district]] of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]]. GA security operated [[Galactic Alliance Security Detention Center 81|detention centers]] and provided security for the [[Armand Isard Correctional Facility]].

Security [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] wore blue [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and helmets, although in some instances they were given black riot armor. Galactic Alliance Security was also known to work with [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], including members of [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]]'s [[Daala's special-missions force|special-missions force]] [[Dhidal Nyz]], [[Vrannin Vaxx]], [[Hrym Mawarr]], and [[Jesmin Tainer|Zilaash Kuh]]. In 43.5 ABY, when several [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] began to fall prey to a strange [[Force psychosis|psychosis]], several Galactic Alliance Security troopers were used by the government to assist in dealings with the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]].

==Organization==
{{Quote|GA Security has legal jurisdiction, those others have profit motive, and all we have is the fact that we're right.|Luke Skywalker, after Valin Horn's capture|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
GA Security was led by the [[Head of Galactic Alliance Security]]. When it was formed after the Second Galactic Civil War, the Head of GA Security also served as the [[Director of Galactic Alliance Intelligence]]. Other high ranks included that of [[Superintendent/Legends|Superintendent]] and [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]]. Beneath them were [[Captain/Legends|Captains]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenants]], and [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeants]].

Galactic Alliance Security forces also worked with bounty hunters and mercenaries, occasionally operating alongside the members of Natasi Daala's special-missions force. They employed the services of such hunters as the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]-carrying [[Jesmin Tainer|Zilaash Kuh]] and the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] inventor Dhidal Nyz. Security forces also worked with the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] mercenary Vrannin Vaxx, the Rodian bounty hunter Kaddit, and [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] bounty hunter and [[Politics/Legends|politician]] [[Hrym Mawarr]].<ref name="Outcast" />

==History==
===A new crisis===
Galactic Alliance Security became a major security force for the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], a Security force under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Savar]] was sent to arrest [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on charges of dereliction of duty for failing to prevent [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]-turned-[[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Caedus]]' fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] during the war. The force also included three [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] who were members of [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]]'s [[Daala's special-missions force|special-missions force]]&mdash;Zilaash Kuh, [[Dhidal Nyz]], and [[Hrym Mawarr]]. During the arrest, one of the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], [[Bessen]], inadvertently opened fire on Skywalker, but the situation was brought back under control. Skywalker was taken to a [[Galactic Alliance Security blockhouse]], although he was released soon after.<ref name="Outcast" />

Security forces, again led by Savar and including bounty hunters Kuh and another member of Daala's force, [[Kaddit]], were later sent to capture Jedi Knight [[Valin Horn]], who had gone on a destructive rampage through the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of Coruscant after a [[Force psychosis|psychotic breakdown]]. Horn was captured by Skywalker, however, and Security forces attempted to force Skywalker to hand the fugitive over. Eventually a compromise was reached, and Horn was placed in the [[Mon Mothma Memorial Medical Center]]. However, after Skywalker's [[The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances versus Luke Skywalker|trial]] and subsequent [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]], Horn was moved to the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="Outcast" />

Security [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] were later issued a warrant for the arrest of Horn, and Captain [[Oric Harfard]] led several troopers, accompanied by Zilaash Kuh and the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Vrannin Vaxx]], to the Temple to arrest Horn. The Jedi Knight was then put on [[The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances versus Valin Horn|trial]], [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|encased]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], and placed in the [[Armand Isard Correctional Facility]], a Galactic Alliance [[Prison/Legends|prison]].<ref name="Outcast" />

===Jedi interventions===
Security forces were later present during rogue Jedi [[Seff Hellin]]'s [[Raid on the Armand Isard Correctional Facility|attempt to free Horn]] from the Armand Isard Correctional Facility. Once again they employed the use of bounty hunters Kuh and Nyz, however, they were unable to capture Hellin, as he was caught by [[Darkmeld]]&mdash;a secret organization founded by Jedi Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] to counter Daala's [[Anti-Jedi sentiment/Legends|anti-Jedi]] policies. Galactic Alliance Security troops led by Harfard arrived at the Jedi Temple the next day to arrest Hellin, however, as Solo had kept the Darkmeld organization a secret from the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]], acting [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Kenth Hamner]] truthfully told Harfard that he didn't know where Hellin was.<ref name="Outcast" />

Soon after, Horn's sister, [[Jysella Horn]], developed the same psychosis as her brother. She fled from the Temple and [[Skirmish on the Processional Way|fought]] with Jedi Knights [[Bazel Warv]] and [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]] before being captured by Security forces. The two Horn children were transferred to a covert Galactic Alliance Security blockhouse under the command of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Wruq Retk]].<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref>

Before long, Warv and Saav'etu also developed the psychosis. They were captured by Solo, [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]], and Solo's parents, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], outside of the Jedi Temple's [[Jedi Temple/Legends|speeder entrance]]. Galactic Alliance Security Captain [[Atar]] soon arrived with a warrant for Warv and Saav'etu's arrests, however, the two Jedi had already been secured inside the Temple, and Han and Leia Solo returned to the Temple and shut the entrance behind them to buy time. Fel used his diplomatic immunity to leave the scene with Jaina Solo in his [[Limousine/Legends|limousine]]. Atar was frustrated with his failure to capture the psychotic Jedi, however, and ordered that Fel and Solo be prevented to leave. A Security team under the command of a [[Unidentified Duros lieutenant|Duros officer]] blocked the limo's path in their [[Galactic Alliance Security assault speeder|assault speeder]], but Fel convinced Atar to let them leave.<ref name="Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>

===Jedi propaganda===
The [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] soon formulated a plan to reveal the darker side of Galactic Alliance Security and gain the sympathy of the public. They [[Mind trick/Legends|tricked]] Head [[Judge/Legends|Judge]] of the [[Court of Jedi Affairs]] [[Arabelle Lorteli]] into granting them a document giving them visitation rights to the Horn siblings. Jaina Solo arrived at the secret [[Galactic Alliance Security Detention Center 81|Galactic Alliance Security blockhouse]], where two Security troopers attempted to prevent her entrance. One of them, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Weeze]], raised an alarm, alerting several nearby Security forces to the danger. Soon, however, several Jedi Masters arrived, along with the Horns' mother, [[Mirax Terrik Horn]], and a large contingent of press. The Security forces arrived with Atar at their helm, but as he was shown the Jedi's document, he was forced to allow them access to the Horns. He ordered a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] Security [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]], [[Rasher Ke'e]], to prevent the press from accessing the Horns, but the Jedi neglected Ke'e's instructions and ensured that the press followed them.<ref name="Abyss" />

The Jedi and press found that the Horns were being held at the executive level of the building, where they were being treated as office decorations. Colonel Wruq Retk, commander of the facility, arrived and attempted to provoke the Jedi in front of the press, but Terrik Horn, furious at Retk's treatment of her children, assaulted him, knocking him out. The present Security forces began calling for her arrest, but at the prompting of Jaina Solo, [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Javis Tyrr]] presented a question to one of the Security [[Officer/Legends|officers]], Captain [[Xanda]], which made their claims sound ridiculous. Chief of State Natasi Daala quickly arrived and announced that charges would not be pressed. The Jedi took the mission to be a success; they had shown the public the corruption of Daala's courts, as well as the apparent cruelty with which Galactic Alliance Security treated the Horns.<ref name="Abyss" />

The Jedi Order soon after succeeded in smuggling several psychotic Knights off-world.<ref name="Abyss" /> However, as more Jedi fell prey to the psychosis, Daala continued to order that they be turned over to the government. When the Jedi Order refused her, she turned to the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] rather than continuing to use Galactic Alliance Security forces, issuing first a [[Raid on the New Jedi Temple|raid]]<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref> and later a [[Siege of the New Jedi Temple|siege]] of the Jedi Temple by the Mandalorians.<ref name="Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref> During the siege, the Jedi called for a public meeting with Daala to turn over their psychotic Knights. Daala agreed and brought with her [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Thalleus Tharn]] and a Galactic Alliance Security contingent led by Captain Oric Harfard. The meeting was a Jedi ploy, however&mdash;they had recently discovered that their Knights were healed from the psychosis, and thus sought to force Daala to end the siege. When [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], acting as spokesperson for the Jedi, announced that the two formerly psychotic Jedi were leaving the Temple, Harfard protested heavily, as he feared the Jedi were attempting to harm the Chief of State. Daala ignored him, however, allowing the two Knights&mdash;[[Turi Altamik]] and [[Sothais Saar]]&mdash;to approach and be examined by Doctor Tharn. Tharn pronounced them cured, and Daala ordered Captain Harfard to lift the siege.<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>

===Discredited===
In the shadows of Coruscant political spheres, a [[Lecersen Conspiracy|conspiracy]] was planning to remove Natasi Daala as Chief of State of the Galactic Alliance as part of their plans for a new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The recent slave uprisings added to the growing dissent in public opinion had led to a great deal of paranoia from Daala who begun trusting her closest allies less and less. Even the GAS was under suspicion.

The conspirators decided to use that when they also realized that a member of the GAS at the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Javon Thewles]], was being accosted by an undercover Jedi Knight, [[Seha Dorvald]]. They faked a poisoning of three of their fellow conspirators, [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Drikl Lecersen]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Merratt Jaxton]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Fost Bramsin]], as well as the [[Galactic Alliance Senate|Senate]] [[Water/Legends|water]] supply. Dorvald's identity was leaked to the Galactic Alliance, and she was arrested. Thewles's link to Dorvald led to his arrest on the charge of conspiracy to murder but he was soon released due to lack of evidence. The damage had been done however as Daala no longer trusted the GAS and she relieved them of the charge of Senate protection. [[Galactic Alliance Fleet Intelligence|Fleet Intelligence]], whom Daala trusted more due to her own experience in the navy, were charged with Senate security.

However, Fleet Intelligence were under the control of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Sallinor Parova]], a member of the conspiracy. As they moved to depose Daala, the Jedi [[Plan Delta|launched a coup of their own]] which ended in them storming the Senate Building and having Daala arrested. A transitional government was formed: a [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|Triumvirate]] between [[Grand Master/Legends|acting Grand Master]] [[Saba Sebatyne]], Senator [[Haydnat Treen]] and General Jaxton.

===Changes===
After the dissolution of the Triumvirate when Luke Skywalker decided to remove the Jedi Order from Coruscant, the Senate elected an interim Chief of State. Although [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padnel Ovin]] was originally elected, members of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] had infiltrated Coruscant so as to take over the government and prepare for their plans for galactic domination. Due to the actions of [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Ivaar Workan]], who was working undercover as Senator Kameron Suldar, the Jedi were discredited as having committed abuses of power during their tenure in the government. A Senate subcommittee, led by Workan, was formed to investigate said actions and the GAS arrested the only Jedi remaining on Coruscant, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]. The Jedi retaliated by attacking the Sith who had infiltrated the GA government and the GAS, including a superintendent. Though the Jedi were victorious in killing most Sith, Coruscant was badly damaged including the [[Galactic Justice Center]].<ref name="Apocalypse" />

In the aftermath of the arrest of the GAS head, [[Borath Maddeus]], for his actions in the [[Lecersen Conspiracy|Imperial-Alliance conspiracy]], [[Garik Loran]] was named as head of the GAS and Galactic Alliance Intelligence.<ref name="X-Wing: Mercy Kill" />
